en.answer:
If, while both <<6682>> and <<7858>> are applying their effects, <<7858>> would be sent to the Graveyard, the effect of <<6682>> would be applied, and <<7858>> would not be sent to the Graveyard. As a result, you cannot send <<7858>> to the Graveyard to Special Summon <<8008>>.

Furthermore, if both <<6682>> and <<7858>> are applying, you can send <<6682>> to the Graveyard to Special Summon <<8008>>.
en.question: While the effects of both <<6682>> and <<7858>> are applying, cards that would be sent to the Graveyard will not be banished. In this situation, can I try to send <<7858>> to the Graveyard to Special Summon <<8008>>?
en.title: While <<6682>> is applying its effect, can I send <<7858>> to the Graveyard to Special Summon <<8008>>?

ja.answer:
「<<6682>>」と「<<7858>>」の効果が適用されている時に、「<<7858>>」を墓地へ送る場合、「<<6682>>」の効果が適用され、墓地へ送る事ができなくなる為、「<<7858>>」を墓地へ送り、「<<8008>>」を特殊召喚する事はできません。
なお、「<<6682>>」と「<<7858>>」の効果が適用されている時に、「<<6682>>」を墓地へ送り、「<<8008>>」を特殊召喚する事ができます。
